name: EU publishes first AI Act harmonised standard for high-risk providers
title: First harmonised standard supporting the AI Act published in the Official Journal
headline: EU publishes first AI Act harmonised standard for high-risk providers
lede: Providers of high-risk AI systems in the EU now have a defined operational quality management system to build or adopt in order to gain presumption of conformity with Article 17.

effects.effect: Lifecycle QMS processes become the reference for high-risk compliance

appearances.title: First harmonised standard supporting the AI Act published in the Official Journal
appearances.headline: EU publishes first AI Act harmonised standard for high-risk providers
appearances.newly_constrained: Providers of high-risk AI systems in the EU now have a defined operational quality management system to build or adopt in order to gain presumption of conformity with Article 17.
appearances.why: Teams placing high-risk AI systems on the EU market now have a concrete QMS benchmark to meet.
appearances.limits: further harmonised standards still expected; high-risk requirements not yet applying

ripples.effect: Lifecycle QMS processes become the reference for high-risk compliance

sources.name: European Commission: digital strategy (AI Act)
sources.title: First harmonised standard supporting the AI Act published in the Official Journal

constraint.who: Providers of high-risk AI systems in the EU
constraint.quote: Organisations without ISO/IEC 42001 that plan to place or put into service high-risk AI systems in the EU market can use EN 18286 to expand an existing QMS or build one that fulfills the requirements of article 17 requirements.
constraint.harder: Providers of high-risk AI systems in the EU now have a defined operational quality management system to build or adopt in order to gain presumption of conformity with Article 17.
